summary: Improve refrigerant inventories, leak records and recovery traceability. Explore this practical five-day compliance course and strengthen audit readiness.
lede: Ozone-depleting substances and F-gas controls training helps refrigeration technicians, facility engineers and compliance specialists track refrigerants and respond to leaks. You practise classifying refrigerants, reconciling asset and charge records, and documenting leak repairs, recovery and disposal to identify evidence gaps and plan corrective actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who handle refrigerant assets, maintenance records, leakage response or environmental compliance for refrigeration and air-conditioning systems.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of refrigeration, air-conditioning or heat-pump equipment and routine service records is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
